name: @w6w-apps/salesloft
description: Manage Salesloft people, accounts, cadences, cadence enrollment, calls, notes, tasks and users.

w6w.longDescription:
Salesloft brings a sales engagement platform's core resources into a workflow — people (contacts), accounts (companies), cadences (sequences), and the calls, notes and tasks that log engagement with them. Person and account actions cover the full create/read/list/update/delete set, while cadence actions list and fetch the sequences a team runs, and cadence membership actions enroll a person into a cadence (optionally starting at a specific step) or remove them from one.

Call actions log a phone call against a person and list past calls; note actions create and list notes associated with a person or account; task actions create, list, update and delete the follow-up tasks a rep works from. User actions list and fetch the Salesloft team members (not CRM contacts) a workflow needs to assign work to.

This is a focused surface on Salesloft's most-used v2 API resources — the generic activity-logging endpoint (which needs Salesloft-internal action/task ids this app does not expose), email activity sync, bulk import/export jobs, and CRM-sync configuration are deliberately left out.
